audit_dimensions.note: Arc moves from purpose/recollection to prayer method, examen, reading, ordinary duties, rule of life, action, reparation/devotion and integration.
All 76 SOT claims carry explicit source IDs; school-specific method is labelled as such.
Tanquerey is the synthetic spine, controlled by St Francis de Sales, St Ignatius, Chautard, Scripture and magisterial/canonical sources. No modern movement is treated as owner of the tradition.
Every lesson has one non-scored application, reflection, review or knowledge check; no lesson ends in a trivial reveal-answer button.
Prayer execution, Confession, Mass, Catechism, Calendar and Apostolate remain external canonical owners.
No streaks, ranks, holiness scoring or sin-performance charts; traditional examen counts are explicitly demoted from goal to optional method.
General examen is finite; particular examen is one point; dryness is not treated as failure; no persistent sin ledger is authorized.
All lesson titles, summaries, teaching blocks, prompts and guidance have EN/FR copy.
Method is subordinate to prayer; vocal and mental prayer are explicitly complementary; Saint-Sulpice is one method among several.
Final lesson explicitly teaches that maturity should reduce dependence on the app rather than increase it.
Advanced mystical phenomena, visions, priest/religious-specific ascetics, generic life-planning and AI-generated meditation remain excluded.

repaired_during_audit.issue: Mental prayer lesson did not explicitly explain its relationship to vocal prayer.
repaired_during_audit.repair: Added SL03-Q07 and bilingual course copy stating that vocal and mental prayer are complementary rather than rivals.

known_runtime_requirements: Do not implement Catholic Life-style static claim cards plus reveal-answer pedagogy.
Use lesson navigation with a readable focus area; source provenance should be accessible but not dominate the main reading flow.
Practices are optional learning/application prompts, never spiritual performance scores.
Source drawer must resolve claim IDs to SOT source records and original links.
Owner handoffs should launch the canonical surface rather than duplicating prayer or ritual content.
Phone acceptance is enforced by the Formation Playwright regression gate.
